help: HELP! HELP-ISH!
Help! Help-ish! Help soon!
Unhand me! I have a book club tonight!
Somebody! This brute smells like ham!
Help! He is squeezing my casserole!
Put me down! My chiropractor is on vacation!
Help! I am too suburban for this!
Let go! I have coupons that expire today!
Help! He took my good cardigan!
Excuse me! Excuse me! I am being grabbed!
Oh no. Oh no no no. Help, please!
Help! My lawn will not mow itself!
Somebody help! I bruise easily and I am very litigious!
Put me down, you ruffian!
Help! I left the oven on!
Help! This is not in my homeowners policy!
Unhand me, sir! I am a doctor! Sort of!
Help! He is getting sweat on my sweater vest!
Somebody call the HOA! No! Call anyone better!
Help me and I will give you the good parking spot!
I am being kidnapped! Adult-napped! Help!
rescue: MY HERO! HAVE A SNACK.
My hero! Have a snack!
Thank you! Take this. It is from my fanny pack.
You saved me! I will not report the hedge you broke.
Bless you! Here, I baked this. Do not ask when.
My hero! Here is a casserole. It is mostly cheese.
Oh, thank goodness. Here, take my emergency granola.
Thank you! I will mention you in the newsletter. Page six.
You are a credit to the cul-de-sac!
Saved! Here, have a muffin. It fell on the ground first.
Thank you! Have this sandwich. I took one bite.
My savior! Have a snack. I have so many snacks. I am a nervous eater.
Golly! Thank you! I have nothing to give you but this weird old cracker.
You saved me from that brute! Have some of my pudding.
Thank you, neighbor! Here, my wife made this. I do not like it.
Rescued! I owe you a fruit basket. Here is one fruit.
Thank you so much! Take this snack before Biscuit gets it.
My knight in shining... whatever that is! Have a snack!
You are so brave! Here is a healthy snack. Sorry.
Thank you! I was going to give this to the bake sale. You win.
Oh, bless you. Have this. It is from the potluck. It is still warm. Somehow.
ko: Oh! Golly. That was my good hip.
I am putting this in the neighborhood group chat.
I will be writing a strongly worded letter. In crayon. My hands are shaking.
My insurance does not cover families.
I just had my teeth whitened. Now I just have teeth. Some teeth.
Is this about the leaf blower? I can explain the leaf blower.
I mowed my lawn for this?
That is the third time this week. I live here.
I am calling the homeowners association. They will fine you. They fine everyone.
The HOA is going to fine ME for lying on the grass.
Please keep off the grass. And off my face.
My casserole! I dropped my casserole!
The casserole was for the potluck. Now it is for the pavement.
I was walking my dog. Where is my dog? Run, Biscuit!
Biscuit ran. Biscuit was always smarter than me.
I knew I should have moved to the country.
I just came out for the newspaper.
I was only checking my mail. My mail was bills. This is worse.
Ow. My sciatica. My everything-atica.
My chiropractor is going to buy a boat with this.
I am fine. I am fine. I am lying in a hedge.
This hedge was trimmed into a swan. Now it is a duck.
My garden gnome saw everything.
I bruise like a banana. A sad, suburban banana.
Golly, sorry you had to do that! No. Wait. You did not have to do that.
I baked you cookies last week!
I took you a fruit basket when you moved in!
I pay my taxes! I pay so many taxes!
My pension! I mean my spine!
I am a medical doctor. I mail-ordered the diploma. Ow.
Doctor Discount recommends ice. Doctor Discount recommends a lawyer.
My prescription says rest. Not like this!
I have a coupon for this kind of injury. Somewhere.
Principal Cutbacks gives you detention. For life. Ow.
This is going on your permanent record. My record is also permanent now. In bruises.
We cut the gym program. I see now we should not have.
We cut the nurse. I regret that so much right now.
Sadsack Sal strikes out again.
My wife left me. My car left me. Now my lunch is leaving me.
This is the best thing that happened to me all week. That is the sad part.
At least somebody noticed me.
Sal does not get hugs. Sal gets this.
My toupee! Did anyone see where my toupee went?
My toupee is in the gutter. It looks happier there.
I wet myself a little. It is the excitement.
That is a lawsuit. That is a class action lawsuit.
Ow. Which cartridge is this? I want a different one.
I am an extra. Extras do not get hit. Read the contract!
I am not even supposed to be in this level.
I was promised I was background scenery!
I have three kids and a mortgage!
I have a cat and a timeshare!
My timeshare is in a better neighborhood than this.
Do you have any idea what my lawn cost?
My lawn is greener than your manners.
I see the light. It is the neighbor's motion sensor. It is so bright.
My knees just filed for divorce.
My knees and my wife, both in one year.
I was going to the farmers market! The kale is everywhere now!
The kale did not save me. Kale never saves anyone.
I just finished my yoga class. I am more flexible than I wanted to be.
Namaste down here for a while.
Oh gosh. Oh heck. Oh fiddlesticks.
Heck. Heck heck heck.
Goodness gracious, my gracious goodness.
That language! I mean, that fist!
I would like to speak to the manager of this street.
Is there a customer service number for getting punched?
I am giving this neighborhood one star.
My minivan is watching. It is disappointed.
I tripped over my own sprinkler.
I was just jogging. I should not have been jogging.
Jogging is so bad for you. Look at me.
I hope you are happy with your points. You lost points. Good.
You lose points for that! I checked the rules!
The house rules say do not hit the neighbors!
I am a neighbor! It said so on the title card!
I am telling your mother. I know your mother.
I am telling the whole cul-de-sac.
My book club will hear about this. Every one of us is angry.
I spilled my latte. I tip my barista for nothing.
I am bleeding latte.
My bunions are throbbing.
Ow! I just got my hip replaced! It came with a warranty!
My hearing aid flew into the storm drain.
WHAT? WHAT DID YOU SAY? OW.
I got knocked right out of my sandals.
My socks and sandals are separated. Like my parents.
My cardigan is ruined. It was my thinking cardigan.
Oh no. Not the sweater vest.
I wore a sweater vest for this.
I was going to vote for your family! Not anymore!
Do not worry about me. I will just lie here. Forever.
Somebody call my sister. She will not come. Call her anyway.
The ice cream truck is playing my song. It is so sad.
My barbecue is still on! My burgers will burn!
My burgers are burning. My face is burning. Everything burns.
I am sorry I yelled at your kids for the ball in my yard.
That ball in my yard. I kept it. I am sorry. Ow.
Truly, neighbors, this is a new low.
spawn: Howdy, neighbor! Lovely day for it!
Is that a family? Fighting? On a weekday?
I am just out for my afternoon power walk.
Has anyone seen my cat? He is orange. He is a jerk.
I am walking my dog. My dog is walking me.
Excuse me. Excuse me. I am just a bystander.
I am standing by. That is my job. I am a bystander.
Do not mind me. I am scenery.
Afternoon! Did you get my flyer about the parking?
I am on my way to the bake sale. Please do not punch the pies.
I brought deviled eggs. They are a little warm.
The deviled eggs have been in my trunk since Tuesday.
I am Doctor Discount. My clinic is in my van.
The van is also my house.
Principal Cutbacks, here. We cut recess. And lunch. And windows.
Sadsack Sal, here. Everything is fine. Nothing is fine.
I got a parking ticket on my own driveway.
I just washed my car. It is going to rain. Or punch.
Oh, a brawl! I love a brawl! From a distance!
I am filming this for the neighborhood watch.
Neighborhood watch! I am watching! That is all I do!
Lovely weather. Lovely violence.
My medical degree came in the mail. With a free pen.
Do you smell burgers? That is my barbecue. Stay away from it.
I am selling raffle tickets for the school. The prize is a raffle ticket.
Would you like to sign my petition? It is against noise. And you.
Hello, I am new to the area. Is it always like this?
I moved here for the schools. The schools are closed.
Watch out for my rose bushes. I have names for them.
Hi! Do you have a moment to talk about lawn care?
Afternoon. I found a sock in my gutter. Is it yours?
I am here for the yard sale. Is this the yard sale? It looks like a yard war.
Everything is fifty cents. Including my dignity.
Hold on, I have to tie my sneaker. My orthopedic sneaker.
I am the president of the garden club. Fear my shears.
Not again. Every Saturday it is a family brawl.
Can you all keep it down? Some of us nap at two.
I am the nice neighbor. I will apologize to you when you hit me.
Oh, hello! Please do not. Thank you!
I got lost on my way to the pharmacy. Is this the pharmacy?
